title: Interview Mastery for Tech Roles
summary: Prepare for resume screens, technical rounds and HR conversations.
description: Short and focused. You will rewrite your resume, practise with mock interviews, and get specific feedback on how you answer.
outcomes: Rewrite your resume for the roles you want
Explain projects clearly in under two minutes
Handle technical and behavioural questions
Negotiate an offer with confidence

title: UI/UX Design Foundations
summary: Learn research, wireframing and visual design by redesigning a real product.
description: You will interview users, map their problems, and deliver a tested prototype. The course ends with a portfolio case study you can send to employers.
outcomes: Plan and run short user interviews
Turn findings into wireframes and flows
Apply layout, colour and type with intent
Test a prototype and write up a case study

title: Python for Data Analysis
summary: Clean, explore and visualise real datasets with Python, pandas and Matplotlib.
description: Start with zero Python and finish by presenting findings from a dataset you chose yourself. Every week uses data from Indian public sources, not toy examples.
outcomes: Write readable Python for everyday analysis tasks
Clean messy data with pandas
Create charts that answer a clear question
Present findings in a short written report

title: Digital Marketing Essentials
summary: Plan and measure campaigns across search, social and email.
description: Learn how a small team gets its first thousand customers. You will run a live campaign with a small budget and report on the results.
outcomes: Build a simple funnel and campaign plan
Write ads and landing page copy that converts
Set up analytics and read the numbers
Run a small paid campaign and report on it

title: Full-Stack Web Development with React & Node
summary: Build and deploy three complete web apps with React, Node and PostgreSQL.
description: You will move from components to databases to deployment, shipping a real project every four weeks. Code reviews on every submission keep your habits honest.
outcomes: Structure a React app with routing, state and data fetching
Design REST APIs with Node and Express
Model data in PostgreSQL and secure it with authentication
Deploy a production app with CI and environment config

title: Professional Writing & Communication
summary: Write emails, updates and documents that people actually read.
description: Clear writing is the cheapest career upgrade there is. Weekly exercises use your own workplace messages, with edits from your instructor.
outcomes: Write short emails that get replies
Structure updates and proposals
Give and receive feedback calmly
Present your ideas in meetings

title: SQL & Databases for Developers
summary: Write confident SQL queries and design clean database schemas.
description: Learn to ask precise questions of data and to structure tables that stay maintainable. Practice runs on a realistic online store database.
outcomes: Write joins, aggregates and subqueries
Design normalised schemas with keys and constraints
Read a query plan and add the right index
Use Supabase and Postgres in a real project

title: Product Management Fundamentals
summary: Learn to find the right problem, prioritise, and ship with a team.
description: A practical course for aspiring PMs and engineers moving into product. You will write a product brief and defend it in a mock review.
outcomes: Frame problems and write a clear product brief
Prioritise with a method you can explain
Work with engineers and designers day to day
Define success metrics and read the results

title: Cloud Fundamentals on AWS
summary: Understand core cloud services and launch your first scalable app on AWS.
description: A hands-on introduction to compute, storage, networking and cost control. You will deploy, break and fix a small application along the way.
outcomes: Explain how core AWS services fit together
Launch and secure a web app on EC2 and S3
Set up monitoring and billing alerts
Prepare for the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam
syllabus: Cloud concepts and the AWS console

title: Brand Identity Design
summary: Create a logo system, palette and brand guide for a real small business.
description: Work through the full identity process, from positioning to a finished guideline document. Each learner works with a partner business brief.
outcomes: Define brand positioning in a short brief
Design a flexible logo system
Choose type and colour that hold together
Package a brand guide for handoff

title: Prototyping & Motion in Figma
summary: Build interactive prototypes with components, variables and smart animate.
description: Go beyond static screens. You will build a mobile app prototype that feels real enough to test with users.
outcomes: Build reusable components with variants
Use variables for themes and states
Animate transitions with purpose
Share prototypes for testing and handoff

title: Financial Modeling for Startups
summary: Build a three-statement model and a fundraising scenario in a spreadsheet.
description: For founders and analysts who need numbers they can defend. You will build a model from scratch and stress-test it.
outcomes: Build revenue and cost projections from assumptions
Link income, balance sheet and cash flow
Model runway and dilution scenarios
Present a model to an investor
